about: A researcher, a writer and a critic explain the phases of the moon to a ten-year-old. Every agent runs on the Strong model of Anthropic.
how: The three agents work in a chain; each gets the task and the text of the one before. All three use Strong.
learns: The strongest model on every step is the most expensive; most of these steps would do well on a lighter model.
watch: How long each step is and how long the run takes, then compare with the twin run that uses lighter models.
